verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack shows Ashby offering data retention or deletion controls for AI-native users (e.g., no docs on configurable retention periods, deletion APIs, or AI-specific data controls). The only related item is a community report that an AI opt-out/deletion form was broken and did nothing when submitted, which further suggests such controls are not reliably available. missing for 10: documentation of retention policy settings, deletion API/endpoint, AI-specific data control features, confirmation the opt-out mechanism works.
